name: innernet Self-Hosted WireGuard Private Networking
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-managed WireGuard coordination server and client tools with CIDR and peer access controls; no vendor software subscription or published peer quota.
watch_out: Requires a self-operated coordination server reachable by peers, WireGuard dependencies and network configuration; server/VPS and bandwidth may cost money. Upstream warns that the software has not received an independent security audit and should be treated as experimental.
